say:1:1620612001:0.text: Okay... my legs aren't shaking anymore. Thanks...
say:1:1620612001:0.male: Okay... my legs aren't shaking anymore. Thanks...
say:1:1620612001:0.female: Okay... my legs aren't shaking anymore. Thanks...

say:2:1620612002:0.text: What did you mean by "ghost" just now?
say:2:1620612002:0.source_cn: 你刚刚说的幽灵，是怎么回事？

say:3:1620612003:0.text: Well, there's a rumor going around the Serene Lyceum. Some students have gone missing, and folks think it's got something to do with it.
say:3:1620612003:0.source_cn: 是流传莱希拉姆的传闻，有些学生失踪据说也跟这些传闻有关。

say:4:1620612004:0.text: One version of the rumor says it's a ghost behind it all.
say:4:1620612004:0.source_cn: 其中有一个版本……就跟“幽灵”有关。

say:5:1620612005:0.text: They say that strange voice isn't from our world at all. It comes from... another realm, or so they claim. Whatever that means.
say:5:1620612005:0.source_cn: 据说那种声音不是这个世界的东西，是从“另一边”传来的。

say:6:1620612006:0.text: And if you follow it, that's when the ghost takes you. No one knows where, and no one's ever made it back.
say:6:1620612006:0.source_cn: 只要你顺着那声音走，就会被幽灵带走——永远不会回来……

choice_prompt:7:1620612006.text: And if you follow it, that's when the ghost takes you. No one knows where, and no one's ever made it back.
choice_prompt:7:1620612006.source_cn: 只要你顺着那声音走，就会被幽灵带走——永远不会回来……

say:8:1620612007:0.text: It's not interesting when people disappear for real!
say:8:1620612007:0.source_cn: 失踪可不是开玩笑的……很可能再也回不来了！

say:9:1620612009:0.text: I'm scared too... but I still want to go and see for myself.
say:9:1620612009:0.source_cn: 我其实也很怕……可我想过去看看。

say:10:1620612010:0.text: You want to go after it? Come on, we're first-years, we haven't even learned how to fend off ghosts! What do you plan to do, talk it into leaving?
say:10:1620612010:0.source_cn: 你居然想去看看，你真的不怕吗？我们是新生，连驱逐幽灵的...

say:11:1620612011:0.text: I just don't want to end up scared of my own classroom... If I back out now, I'll never be able to go back—and I've still got years of late-night studying ahead!
say:11:1620612011:0.source_cn: 我只是……不想连在教室自习都变成心理阴影。如果现在退缩...

say:12:1620612012:0.text: And hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is with us, right? If anything, this might be the perfect chance to explore something no one else dares to.
say:12:1620612012:0.male: And hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is with us, right? If anything, this might be the perfect chance to explore something no one else dares to.
say:12:1620612012:0.female: And hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is with us, right? If anything, this might be the perfect chance to explore something no one else dares to.

say:13:1620612013:0.text: <shk>You're all out of your mind!</shk> That ghost's gonna drag you off and you'll never be seen again!
say:13:1620612013:0.source_cn: <shk>你们简直疯了！</shk>幽灵会把你们拖走的！

choice_prompt:14:1620612013.text: <shk>You're all out of your mind!</shk> That ghost's gonna drag you off and you'll never be seen again!
choice_prompt:14:1620612013.source_cn: <shk>你们简直疯了！</shk>幽灵会把你们拖走的！

say:15:1620612014:0.text: Ugh, don't leave me here alone! Wait up!
say:15:1620612014:0.source_cn: 唉，你们不要丢下我自己啊！等等我！

choice:14:0:1.text: If anyone should be scared, it's the ghost.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 你要担心的，是幽灵会害怕我
choice:14:0:1.male: If anyone should be scared, it's the ghost.
choice:14:0:1.female: If anyone should be scared, it's the ghost.

say:17:1620612008:0.text: I mean... I believe in magic too. Just not sure I'm strong enough to handle this kind of thing.
say:17:1620612008:0.source_cn: 我也相信魔法，但……也许我的魔法还不够强吧……

choice:7:1:2.text: I believe in magic. Ghost gossip? Not so much.
choice:7:1:2.male: I believe in magic. Ghost gossip? Not so much.
choice:7:1:2.female: I believe in magic. Ghost gossip? Not so much.
